histogram.name: CriticalActions.ConversationAnchorResolutionOutcome.{ActionSource}
histogram.summary:
Records whether a critical action triggered by {ActionSource} was assigned a conversation anchor (e.g. the Gemini turn that caused it), and if not, why. Recorded once per critical action when it is logged, before it is associated with a history visit, and only while action-level chat linkouts are enabled.
The anchor is the one most recently set for the action's task when the action is logged. Setting the same anchor again (e.g. for each batch of actions of one turn) does not change attribution, but an action that is logged after a different anchor was set (e.g. an asynchronous event from an earlier turn) gets the newer anchor and is still recorded as "Success: Resolved from in-memory cache".
Because it is recorded when the action is logged, this includes actions that are dropped before they are associated with a history visit (see CriticalActions.VisitIdResolutionOutcome.{ActionSource}) and are never saved, so its total is not comparable to CriticalActions.EventLogged.{ActionSource}.
For actor tasks started from Glic, actions that the Glic web client performs without a turn ID clear the task's anchor, so critical actions they cause are recorded as "Failed: Cache miss at enqueue time". The web client sends the same turn ID for all actions of one response turn (e.g. all actuation rounds of one prompt), so the anchor only changes when a new turn starts.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.ConversationIdDeferredResolutionOutcome.{ActionSource}
histogram.summary: Records the final resolution outcome of a deferred conversation ID resolution for a critical action triggered by {ActionSource}.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.ConversationIdResolutionOutcome.{ActionSource}
histogram.summary: Records the resolution outcome of resolving a conversation ID for a critical action triggered by {ActionSource} at the time the action is logged.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.Database.MigrationVacuumResult
histogram.summary: Records whether the SQLite VACUUM operation succeeded after migrating the CriticalActions database from schema V2 to V3 (which drops the url column). Emitted once per database migration at the end of CriticalActionDatabase::Init().

histogram.name: CriticalActions.Database.SqliteError
histogram.summary: Records SQLite result and error codes (e.g. constraint violations, disk I/O errors, corruption) encountered during SQLite operations in CriticalActionDatabase. Recorded in CriticalActionDatabase::DatabaseErrorCallback whenever a database operation or statement execution returns an error code.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.EventLogged.{ActionSource}
histogram.summary: Records the category (e.g. form fill, password manager login, federated login, download, OTP) of each critical action triggered by {ActionSource} that is saved to the critical action history. For most sources, an action is saved once it has been associated with a history visit; actions that are dropped before that are not recorded (see CriticalActions.VisitIdResolutionOutcome.{ActionSource}).

histogram.name: CriticalActions.EventLoggedInRedirect.{RedirectType}.{ActionSource}
histogram.summary: Records the ActionType category of a critical action triggered by {ActionSource} whose visit is redirected to another visit by {RedirectType}. Not recorded for actions on the final visit of a redirect chain. Compare against CriticalActions.EventLogged.{ActionSource} to compute the share of critical actions logged on redirected visits.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.OpenConversation.HasConversationAnchor
histogram.summary: Records whether a critical action has a conversation anchor (e.g. the Gemini turn that caused it) when the user clicks its 'Open chat' button on the Chrome History page. A critical action only has an anchor if one was known when the action was recorded. This doesn't reflect whether the conversation was then opened at that turn. Only recorded while action-level chat linkouts are enabled, and only if the critical action is found, so at most once per CriticalActions.OpenConversationResult.CriticalActionRow sample. It is recorded before the conversation is opened, so it includes attempts that then fail.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.OpenConversationResult.{Source}
histogram.summary: Records the outcome of each attempt to open the Gemini conversation of a critical action from {Source} on the Chrome History page. While action-level chat linkouts are disabled, attempts from CriticalActionRow open the conversation without targeting a turn, but are still recorded under CriticalActionRow.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.VisitIdResolutionOutcome.{ActionSource}
histogram.summary: Records the resolution outcome of resolving a navigation ID to a History Visit ID for a critical action triggered by {ActionSource}. Emitted either when the navigation ID is resolved to a Visit ID or when the pending action is dropped prior to persistence.
